title: Roman Bath and Turkish Hamam
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Mediterranean Travels
description: Hover over and click two stacked floor plans, a Roman bath above and a Turkish hamam below, to compare five stages of the bath and see where the match breaks, then test yourself in Quiz mode.

educational.topic: Roman baths and the Turkish hamam
learningObjectives: The learner will compare the rooms of a Roman bath with the rooms of a Turkish hamam, and for each of five stages state what the two share, where the match breaks, and why the hamam is best described as adapted from the Roman and Byzantine baths, not copied from them.
prerequisites: Chapter 6: Roman Bath Culture and The Turkish Bath

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Side-by-side comparison followed by retrieval practice
keyQuestions: Where does the hamam match the Roman bath, and where does it break?
commonMisconceptions: The hamam is a Roman bath.
Roman baths and hamams are heated the same way.
assessmentOpportunities: Quiz mode: click the zone that matches each idea

controls.name: Explore
controls.description: Default mode: hover a zone for a tooltip, click it for the infobox.

controls.name: Quiz Mode
controls.description: Hides the name pills and asks 9 questions answered by clicking a zone.
